title: Cherry Pickup
goal: Collect the most cherries on a round trip without counting a cell twice.
strategy: Reverse the return trip so both journeys move right and down together. At each shared step, track both row coordinates; columns follow from step minus row. Shared cells contribute their cherry only once.
